purpose: Repeatable collection of the remaining manual, field, and representative-device Phase 8D evidence. This protocol is not itself evidence and does not close the Phase 8D gate.

result_semantics.observed_pass: The recorded sampled flow met the stated checks in the recorded environment.
result_semantics.observed_finding: The recorded sampled flow exposed a concrete issue that requires follow-up.
result_semantics.inconclusive: The attempted check did not produce enough evidence to support either a sampled pass or a finding.
result_semantics.unavailable: The required environment, telemetry, device, or profiler was not available for the check.

actions: Use the skip link and primary navigation.
Verify the active route and page heading are understandable.
Search the catalogue, move to the next results page, follow a result, and return.
Repeat the usable-flow checks at real browser 200% zoom.
Use fixed test coordinates rather than real location data.
Calculate the plan, change the selected time, and toggle Sky Finder layers.
Save and reopen a plan and exercise cancel and confirm deletion.
Create a journal entry from the planner, open Journal, expand provenance, and exercise cancel and confirm deletion.
Use a harmless local test image.
Operate the consent checkbox and submit controls.
Observe upload and polling success or failure announcements.
Run the local checks, then exercise cancel and confirm deletion.
Consume the canonical non-canvas content before activating the atlas.
Activate the atlas and verify keyboard access around activation and route exit.
Repeat with WebGL unavailable and verify canonical text and provenance remain usable.
Exercise this journey on the representative low-end device.
Change the diagram view and toggle a filter.
Use the keyboard star selector.
Inspect the plot accessible name and description.
Navigate the semantic table and verify contained scrolling at real browser 200% zoom.
Visit and reload the approved lesson online.
Disable connectivity, reload the approved lesson, then request the unvisited lesson.
Exercise the offline fallback.
Use storage controls with keyboard and screen reader, including cancel and confirm clear.
Verify clearing offline cache data does not delete personal saved data.

wcag-2.2-aa-manual-review.claim_boundary: A sampled manual review plus automated axe does not constitute unrestricted WCAG 2.2 AA certification.

screen-reader.claim_boundary: ARIA, axe, and accessibility-tree automation are not substitutes for evidence from a real screen reader in the recorded browser and operating-system combination.

checks: required two-dimensional content uses contained scrolling rather than document overflow
browser-zoom-200.claim_boundary: A sampled 200% browser-zoom observation does not certify every browser, operating system, route, or zoom implementation.

checks: record the actual device, browser, operating system, viewport, DPR, and network condition
observe navigation and interaction usability without synthetic CPU or network substitution
record captured timings only as observations unless a separately approved budget exists
representative-low-end-device.claim_boundary: One recorded device does not establish behavior across all low-end devices, and synthetic throttling remains only a proxy.

checks: use an approved real-user or field telemetry source for a deployed build
record the deployment or build, observation window, instrumentation source, sample population and count, aggregation, segmentation, collection limitations, and privacy review
do not substitute scripted Event Timing or lab interaction measurements
field-inp.claim_boundary: Scripted lab interaction latency is not field INP, and absence of approved telemetry is an evidence gap rather than a software failure.

checks: profile repeated atlas activate, use, and route-leave cycles on representative headed hardware
record the profiler, renderer, hardware, browser, operating system, cycle count, baseline observations, post-leave observations, and renderer or context errors
retain the raw capture or profiler reference when available
retained-gpu-memory.claim_boundary: Observed cleanup on one environment does not prove whole-engine GPU disposal or establish a universal memory-delta threshold.
